scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names API,WEB --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev -w @story-teacher/backend" "npm run dev -w @story-teacher/frontend"
scripts.local: npm run db:up && npm run db:init && npm run db:seed && npm run dev
scripts.local:fresh: npm run db:up && npm run db:reset -w @story-teacher/backend && npm run db:init && npm run db:seed && npm run dev
scripts.test:e2e: npm run db:up && npm run db:reset -w @story-teacher/backend && npm run db:init && npm run db:seed && playwright test
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
